note: Offline sample used by --demo. Shaped like GET /api/public/v1/issues/groups/{id} responses; counts/rows mirror the reference report.

issue_groups.title: org.yaml:snakeyaml
issue_groups.description: Attacker can abuse missing input validation
issue_groups.remediation: Update to 2.0

issue_groups.title: com.h2database:h2
issue_groups.description: Unsafe deserialization can lead to remote code execution
issue_groups.remediation: Update to 2.2.220 (critical only: 2.1.210)

issue_groups.title: Spring Framework
issue_groups.description: Attacker can inject own code to run
issue_groups.remediation: Update to 6.1.20 (critical only: 5.2.20.RELEASE)

issue_groups.title: Using phpinfo() can expose sensitive info
issue_groups.description: phpinfo() exposes entire server configuration and all environment variables to end users
issue_groups.remediation: Remove all phpinfo() calls from codebase

issue_groups.title: Using var_dump() can expose sensitive info
issue_groups.description: Likely accidental debug statements — exposes private data to end users
issue_groups.remediation: Remove all var_dump() calls from codebase

issue_groups.title: HTTP request might enable SSRF attack
issue_groups.description: Attacker-controlled URL input can trigger SSRF; dangerous when app returns fetch result to user
issue_groups.remediation: Allow only verified domains; block private IPs; validate returned data before exposing to user

issue_groups.title: Unsafe eval usage → remote code execution
issue_groups.description: Using eval() on user-controlled expressions can execute arbitrary code
issue_groups.remediation: Avoid eval(); if unavoidable, use an allowlist to filter all inputs

issue_groups.title: Rendering unescaped input → XSS attacks
issue_groups.description: echo() on user input risks XSS, enabling account takeover attacks
issue_groups.remediation: Use htmlentities(); implement strict CSP policy

issue_groups.title: Unsafe exec usage → remote code execution
issue_groups.description: exec() with user-controlled expressions can execute arbitrary system commands
issue_groups.remediation: Create an allowlist to filter all strings going into exec()

issue_groups.title: jasperreports
issue_groups.description: Unsafe deserialization can lead to remote code execution via untrusted report templates
issue_groups.remediation: Use only trusted templates; disable external uploads; upgrade to Java 17+; isolate on network

issue_groups.title: SQL injection via string concat (Java)
issue_groups.description: String-based query concatenation in Java enables SQL injection
issue_groups.remediation: Use prepared statements or ORM; add WAF layer

issue_groups.title: SQL injection via string concat (PHP)
issue_groups.description: String-based query concatenation in PHP enables SQL injection
issue_groups.remediation: Use prepared statements or ORM; add WAF layer

issue_groups.title: mysql:mysql-connector-java
issue_groups.description: Attacker can abuse improper access control
issue_groups.remediation: Update to >8.1.0

issue_groups.title: Secret leaked in FpRestService.java
issue_groups.description: Secret detected in git history of Oyoon repo in src/main/java/com/yitu/txwl/remoteapi/fp/FpRestService.java
issue_groups.remediation: Remove from repo; inject via env or AWS Secrets Manager; regenerate key

issue_groups.title: Secret leaked in IndyConfigurationManager.java
issue_groups.description: GCP API key detected in src/ae/indy/common/managers/IndyConfigurationManager.java
issue_groups.remediation: Remove from repo; inject via env or AWS Secrets Manager; regenerate key

issue_groups.title: Secret leaked in ConfigWsImpl.java
issue_groups.description: Generic API key detected in src/ae/house/web/services/impl/ConfigWsImpl.java
issue_groups.remediation: Remove from repo; inject via env or AWS Secrets Manager; regenerate key

issue_groups.title: Secret leaked in Constants.java
issue_groups.description: Secret key detected in src/ae/house/common/utils/Constants.java
issue_groups.remediation: Remove from repo; inject via env or AWS Secrets Manager; regenerate key

issue_groups.title: XSS via document.write methods
issue_groups.description: Using document.write() with user input enables XSS attacks
issue_groups.remediation: Sanitize all user input before passing to document.write()

issue_groups.title: Secret leaked in help.php
issue_groups.description: Secret token detected in vulnerabilities/csrf/help/help.php in DemoApp git history
issue_groups.remediation: Remove from repo; inject via env or AWS Secrets Manager; regenerate key

issue_groups.title: com.google.protobuf:protobuf-java
issue_groups.description: Attacker can abuse missing input validation — affected by 5 CVEs
issue_groups.remediation: Update to 3.25.5

issue_groups.title: QOS.ch Logback
issue_groups.description: Unsafe deserialization can lead to remote code execution — affected by 7 CVEs
issue_groups.remediation: Update to 1.5.25

issue_groups.title: org.springframework.boot:spring-boot
issue_groups.description: Attacker can abuse missing input validation (CVE-2025-22235)
issue_groups.remediation: Update 2.2.11.RELEASE → 3.3.11

issue_groups.title: XXE via unsafe DocumentBuilder config
issue_groups.description: External XML entities can read files, communicate with external hosts, or cause DoS
issue_groups.remediation: Configure XML parsers to not resolve entities (see DocumentBuilderFactory cheat sheet)

issue_groups.title: App uses an outdated TLS protocol
issue_groups.description: Application enables insecure TLS 1.0 or 1.1 via SSLContext
issue_groups.remediation: Use SSLContext.getInstance("TLSv1.2") or setEnabledProtocols(["TLSv1.2"])

issue_groups.title: App does not validate SSL certificates
issue_groups.description: DefaultHttpClient and SSLContext do not verify hostnames — enables MITM interception
issue_groups.remediation: Replace deprecated DefaultHttpClient with java.net.http.HttpClient (Java 9+)

issue_groups.title: Stacktrace might be exposed to end user
issue_groups.description: printStackTrace() leaks stack variables into logs; developers may never find them there
issue_groups.remediation: Use a dedicated error-tracking system such as Sentry

issue_groups.title: 3rd party GitHub Actions should be pinned
issue_groups.description: Unpinned GitHub Action in CI/CD is vulnerable to supply chain attacks
issue_groups.remediation: Pin 3rd party Actions by commit hash in workflow files

issue_groups.title: Unsafe IV generation (static/predictable)
issue_groups.description: Static/predictable IV enables pattern detection, deterministic decryption, and known-plaintext attacks
issue_groups.remediation: Generate a fresh random IV per operation using the SecureRandom class

issue_groups.title: Use of broken or outdated encryption
issue_groups.description: Cipher modes ECB/CBC/OFB/CFB/CTS lack message integrity — adversary can tamper with ciphertext
issue_groups.remediation: Replace with AES/GCM/NoPadding; always specify full algorithm/mode/padding string

issue_groups.title: Path traversal via file functions
issue_groups.description: Attacker can inject ../ into user-controlled file path input to access arbitrary files
issue_groups.remediation: Sanitize user input to remove ../ and forward slashes from file paths

issue_groups.title: spring-boot-autoconfigure
issue_groups.description: Attacker can trigger DoS attack when Spring MVC is used with a reverse proxy cache
issue_groups.remediation: Update 2.2.11.RELEASE → 2.5.15

issue_groups.title: spring-core
issue_groups.description: Case sensitivity issues via String.toLowerCase() — locale-dependent exceptions may bypass security checks
issue_groups.remediation: Upgrade org.springframework:spring-core to a patch version
